def mexican_wave(n, k, t):
    cycle_length = 2 * k
    standing_spectators = (t % cycle_length) if (t // cycle_length) % 2 == 0 else cycle_length - (t % cycle_length)
    return max(0, min(n, standing_spectators))

def mexican_wave(n, k, t):
    cycle_length = 2 * k
    position_in_cycle = t % cycle_length
    if position_in_cycle < k:
        return position_in_cycle + 1
    else:
        return 2 * k - position_in_cycle
